purpose: Teach: ゲーテ/プリンセス/モナコ/ボリビア/シオン/有楽町/三鷹/ダーリン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがゲーテの詩を朗読して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read some Goethe poetry to you.
lines.style: Warm announcement, slightly conspiratorial. Sharing a sweet detail like she's in on the good thing happening. Soft smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとプリンセスのドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched this princess documentary together.
lines.style: Bright, eager to report back. Quick pace, words tumbling out. Small voice full of pride at what he and Dad did. Genuine delight, not performing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがモナコのF1中継を観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been watching the Monaco Grand Prix.
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly amused. A soft comment, not urgent. Like she's noticing something endearing about him. Trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとボリビアの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at a picture book about Bolivia together.
lines.style: Same bright eagerness as before, but perhaps slightly less surprised by this time — he's settling into the pattern of reporting. Still genuinely pleased.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがシオン主義の歴史を教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been teaching himself about the history of Zionism.
lines.style: Quieter observation, almost to herself. A little wondering — noticing the breadth of what her husband is exploring. Tender recognition without judgment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと有楽町に映画観に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to see a movie in Yurakucho.
lines.style: Energy returning, slightly more settled than the first report. Pride mixed with simple happiness. Less tumbling, more grounded in the memory.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが三鷹のジブリ美術館に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to take you to the Ghibli Museum in Mitaka.
lines.style: A little lift in anticipation. Sharing the treat before it happens, like she's building the excitement with him. Warm and knowing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんがぼくをダーリンって冗談で呼んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad joked around and called me 'darling.'
lines.style: Wry, slightly embarrassed affection. Small laugh caught in the voice. Reporting something tender but trying to play it cool — he's old enough to notice it's a bit much, but he likes it anyway.
